source: Time is running out! Gather whatever you can and toss it into your lifeboat, before the ship sinks. Every item counts! Escape by staying near the boat at the end! However, it can only carry one more person besides you.
The same choice may lead to different outcomes if you try it again in another playthrough!
If your night does get interrupted, use an item you brought to handle the situation. If you have no answer, you can try going back to sleep. Sometimes, that’s your only option.

Use the daytime to spend your energy on fishing, eating, doing small tasks, or chatting to your shipmate (if you brought one).
When you run out of energy, end the day and try to sleep hoping nothing disrupts your rest.

You’re the <color=yellow>captain</color> of a ship on a covert delivery mission with a small crew. Without warning, something strikes the vessel, causing severe damage. You wait for the emergency horns. When they sound, you know you need to evacuate immediately.
